scope: Semantic review of the supplied exact Word body extraction for DOCX 0090 R05; visual pages, independent hash/extraction re-verification, live PR/blob checks, real association records and formal acceptance were not reviewed.
title_blind_purpose: A supervisor-facing assessment instrument for one named observable learning objective, covering baseline, immediate first attempt, observed workplace application, optional sourced result indicators, and a three-outcome decision with follow-up.
requirement_match: PASS — the body matches the official supervisor learning-outcome assessment purpose and Blueprint row 097: one objective, 1–4 anchors, N/O-safe denominator, PASS/HOLD/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE routing, reject rules, complete blank form, synthetic worked case, and replacement register; it does not substitute 0084, 0089 or checkbox 090.
genre: SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC supervisor learning-outcome assessment form plus a completed worked case and replacement register; not a policy, satisfaction survey, or real association record.
usability: PASS — the blank form is operational, the N/O and source-deficiency branches are present, the critical set is fixed at 1,3,4,5, and §7.4 demonstrates the fields; minor form/locator polish remains (see nonblocking findings).
sample_real_boundary: PASS — every case value is marked synthetic, dates are relative, signatures/approval/real names are blank, retest is labeled synthetic, and the register supplies replacement slots; no real person, approval, execution, credential or third-party evidence is asserted.

The completed N/O sample gives reason, checks that no eligible task exists, marks next observation time not applicable, and supplies trigger D+31 and review D+45/D+60.

The register is continuous 01–49, includes case facts and excludes thresholds, N/O routing, reject rules and anchors; the rule-adjacent row -19 records the case's use of the fixed set while the rule remains in §5.1; the cited IDs appear in the body and §7.4 is a field-by-field completed form.

regression_checks.locator: §6.1 step 4 and HOLD row; §4 calculation note; §9 item 13
regression_checks.evidence: The rule expressly routes the all-critical-items-at-least-3, no-critical-N/O, mean-below-3.0 case to HOLD; [3,2,3,3,3] has mean 2.8 and no critical item below 3, so it cannot be left unclassified. The blank form and checklist repeat the rule.

regression_checks.locator: §5.1 fixed-set table and closing note; §4 fixed-item check; §7.3; §7.4
regression_checks.evidence: R05 fixes critical items to 1, 3, 4 and 5 for the whole version; adding or changing critical items requires a new version with anchors, form fields, denominators and decision rules; no blank field invites an unimplemented addition.

5/6 is expressly a five-item D+0 cohort indicator, not a substitute for the three individual conclusions; P05 is cohort not-met but HOLD, and P04 D+0 PASS differs from D+30 HOLD, showing the layers are separate.

The text limits N/O to no eligible task, sends existing-but-locator-missing sources to unscored HOLD, and sends missing or unverifiable sources to rejection plus recalculation; it expressly forbids using N/O for source failure.
The rows for SYN-P01, SYN-P02 and SYN-P03 carry literal IDs SYN-0090-20, SYN-0090-21 and SYN-0090-36.

regression_checks.locator: §6.2.3; §6.1 HOLD and INSUFFICIENT rows; §4 source-deficiency field
regression_checks.evidence: An existing source with missing locator is HOLD and unscored until repaired; a missing or unverifiable source is rejected and the remaining evidence is rejudged, with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE only if the remaining evidence is insufficient.
P04 D-7 is [2,3,2,2,2], 11/5=2.2, critical minimum 2; §7.4 repeats the same vector and A01 row 5 locator without changing the 2/6 cohort.
The relative-change line uses (5/6−2/6)/(2/6)=+150.0% and warns not to back-calculate from the rounded 83.3% and 33.3%.
Cross-references are limited to 0084, 0089, 0090 and official 090; no DOCX 0088 reference appears in the body.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The three-way fixed-critical summary check has no explicit box for a critical item left unscored under the existing-source/locator-missing HOLD branch or the untraceable-source rejection branch; the separate source-deficiency field and §6.2.3 still determine the outcome, so this is a completeness polish rather than a decision-logic blocker.
nonblocking_findings.locator: §4 fixed-item check and source-deficiency field; §6.1 HOLD row; §6.2.3

nonblocking_findings.finding: P01–P03 and the P05 D+3 retest use page-level synthetic locators rather than row or line locators; row-level locators would speed evaluator traceability.

§7.4's denominator field mixes the five-item scoring denominator with the D+30 cohort 4/6 and does not name the two excluded N/O cases in that field; split individual versus cohort denominators or cross-reference §7.2.
§7.2 cites §6.2 item 6 for a 3/6 error, but 3/6 is primarily the denominator/N/O error in item 4 rather than the percentage-point-versus-relative-percentage formula error in item 6.
The TTQS evaluator user is implicit rather than named; a short evaluator cross-check note would improve direct usability.

limits: The DOCX hash, extraction hash, live PR head, blueprint/manual blobs and source-checklist page were not independently re-verified; this review relies on the packet's binding and the supplied body text.
